fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami and Miami Beach civic affairs, including criticism of banks’ use of public funds and calls for investigation; discussion of Florida Power & Light franchises and utility rates; coverage and opinion on the Fred Osius traffic-death case and related law-enforcement actions; notes on Jackson Memorial Hospital administration; debate over airport location (Dinner Key vs. Chapman Field); updates on the county causeway and boatbuilding; hotel business conditions (Floridian Hotel closing); late news briefs (Tamiami Trail oil drilling, Hialeah ex-postmaster Randall, Miami Beach police); sports/boxing promotion; and published financial statements for several local banks and trust companies.
